nodes.name: callback_handlers.md
nodes.summary: Reference guide for all WhatsApp callback button handlers registered in the Ordelo FastAPI app, covering rider accept/decline dispatch, shift availability, restaurant order confirmation, pickup time selection, and admin notification opt-in. Documents 9 handlers with their filter strings, source buttons, actor roles, and step-by-step behavior.

nodes.name: delivery_process.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive reference (v3.1) for the entire Ordelo delivery workflow covering all 6 phases from order creation through delivery completion, with database tables, status state machines, pg_cron scheduled jobs, PostgreSQL triggers, LangGraph rider agent architecture, AgentState TypedDict fields, and SQL file references. The authoritative top-level document for the delivery subsystem.

nodes.name: delivery_process_explorer.html
nodes.summary: Interactive single-page HTML explorer that visualizes the Ordelo delivery process flow, allowing users to navigate all 6 delivery phases, status transitions, and component relationships from the documentation.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript providing a client-side interactive visualization — no server required.

nodes.name: dispatch_flow.md
nodes.summary: Focused deep-dive (v1.1) on the dispatch portion of the delivery workflow covering dispatch creation, rider notification via WhatsApp, accept/decline callback handling, the first-accept race condition resolution using SQL rank(), inflight initialization, missed-dispatch notifications, and the pre-pickup cancellation flow.

nodes.name: get_restaurant_webhook_url_async_guide.md
nodes.summary: API reference guide for the `get_restaurant_webhook_url_async` utility function, documenting its function signature, all 9 valid webhook types (rider-inflight, rider-cust-enter, delivery-timedout, etc.), 5-minute TTL in-memory caching strategy, usage examples with error handling, and migration notes for callers transitioning from a synchronous predecessor.

nodes.name: location_overview.md
nodes.summary: Guide to the OwnTracks-based live location subsystem, tracing the end-to-end flow from PGMQ queue ingestion through `job_process_owntracks()`, insertion into `rider_location` and `rider_location_event` tables, PostgreSQL trigger firing, and FastAPI `/location-hooks/` webhook handling for restaurant and customer zone-entry events.

nodes.name: payment_and_order_flow.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive reference (v1.0) for the order creation and payment lifecycle, covering pre-order validation (min order value by coordinates and postcode), Stripe and pay-at-restaurant payment paths, payment completion handler routing to `init_delivery()` or `init_takeaway()`, address capture via WhatsApp flow, and all related webhook endpoints.

nodes.name: pickup_time_logic.md
nodes.summary: Runtime flow documentation for `pickup_time` in both `delivery_summary` and `takeaway_summary`, covering the full trigger chain from restaurant acceptance through admin pickup-time selection, 5-minute timeout auto-accept path via `process_restaurant_confirmation` scheduled job, mid-delivery adjustment callbacks, and downstream dispatch creation.

nodes.name: takeaway_flow.md
nodes.summary: Complete reference (v1.0) for the takeaway order lifecycle, documenting the parallel flow to delivery (without rider dispatch or live tracking) including Stripe and pay-at-restaurant initialization paths, `takeaway_summary` status machine, restaurant confirmation, pickup time selection, external restaurant notification webhook, and decline/timeout paths.
